payload.explanation: The diagnostic report identifies LOCK_CONTENTION: the business request (session_6935fc92254e) is blocked on a transactionid lock held by session_970d3eeaa7a8, which is idle in transaction after running the same UPDATE and waiting on ClientRead — the root blocker. The state report confirms session_970d3eeaa7a8 is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request session has no allowed actions and must not be modified directly. Rolling back the blocker releases the row lock so the pending decrement can complete; no evidence supports large-data, index, or vacuum causes.
